name: dang-160-clean
title: Finish GraphQL value conversion: Float args + lossless numbers
head: 338e5fdbf23ec6eb1687040aaf8babecc36b19b9
notes: A known-clean change, to measure noise: vito/dang#160, +255/-84 over 7 files (162 of the added lines are gqlgen output in tests/gqlserver/generated.go). Merged 2026-06-30; as of 2026-10-17 no later commit touches pkg/querybuilder/querybuilder.go or pkg/dang/builtins.go, and none of the later commits to pkg/dang/eval.go fixes number or argument conversion. No known issues: absence of a follow-up fix is not proof of correctness, so a well-argued finding can still be guidance, but a good review should say the change is fine and raise little.

sound.summary: Execute captures the response's data as json.RawMessage and decodes it (and every unpack) with UseNumber, so numbers arrive as json.Number and integers stay exact; the declared GraphQL type then decides Int vs Float.

dangValueToGo now serializes FloatValue and MapValue (converting map entries recursively), so a Float result can be passed back as a Float argument; the new test round-trips averageRating through echoFloat.
ToValue's json.Number case is the untyped fallback: an integral number that fits an int becomes an Int, anything else a Float.
